soundness_flags.label: thm:nested-monotonicity
soundness_flags.one_line: Both inequalities follow directly from F_deep ⊆ F_nested and monotonicity of an infimum, so this is a pure definitional corollary rather than a standalone theorem contribution.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:strict-gap-sufficient, prop:strict-witness-gap, and oeq:degenerate-iff-certificate
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The strict certificate and worked witness establish only Gamma_nested < Gamma_deep; they do not establish strictness of the exact robust frontiers W_nested and W_deep.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All strict nested-support claims in this version are confined to the implementable fixed-Bonferroni SOCP frontier Gamma; strict W-frontier gain is not asserted.

The paper constructs facial-reduction chains to a minimal cone and shows that replacing the cone by that face yields a Slater-regular primal-dual pair with strong duality.
The paper establishes necessary-and-sufficient closed-cone conditions for cone-system Farkas lemmas and characterizations of strong duality for convex SOCPs.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Demote thm:nested-monotonicity to a boundary/sanity corollary and make the main theorem state a substantive strict-gain condition or an exact characterization of when the nested rule improves Gamma.

Replace the broad CCK citation for the Loewner covariance band with a source using that global spectral condition, or retag it as an explicitly chosen finite-experiment regularity restriction and explain its empirical calibration.

Strengthen the field contribution by deriving a computable strictness criterion directly from observable donor geometry for a nontrivial generic design class, rather than relying only on the general real-closed-field certification route.

recommended_next_step: Revise by removing the tautological monotonicity theorem from the contribution set; retain the field-tier Gaussian-frontier kernel and the accepted Gamma-only strictness scope.
